name: Tadalafil
summary: Tadalafil, a PDE5 inhibitor used to combat erectile disfunction. Dangerous in combination with other drugs which lower blood pressure.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Tadalafil is a PDE5 inhibitor which increases blood flow to the penis.

uses.text: Tadalafil is used to treat erectile dysfunction, benign prostatic hyperplasia, and pulmonary arterial hypertension. In the United States, tadalafil (as Cialis) is indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction and the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia; and (as Adcirca) for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension to improve exercise ability.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include headache, muscle pain, flushing, and nausea. Rare but serious side effects include a prolonged erection that can lead to damage to the penis, vision problems, and hearing loss.
